name: orbit-explorer
description: Orbital digital twin: every tracked object, Starlink laser-link routing, conjunction screening - from first principles.

scripts.dev: node data/ensure.mjs && pnpm engine:build && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.build: node data/ensure.mjs && pnpm engine:build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: node data/ensure.mjs && pnpm engine:test && pnpm engine:build && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.validate: cargo run --release --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --example validate -- docs/validation/vallado-errors.csv && pnpm --filter web plots
scripts.bench: node data/ensure.mjs && cargo run --release --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --example bench -- web/public/data/catalog.bin
